_comment: ACT 0 — CENTRELINK MUTUAL OBLIGATIONS.
Edit this file on github.com and it is live within five minutes. There is no
deploy. See server/quests.ts for the publish path and what happens when this
file is wrong (nothing: the whole pack is refused and the last good one keeps
serving, with the reasons in the server log).
Every id is lower case, alphanumeric with - _ and :. Every reward is bounded
($500, 2000 xp, 4 flags) and a quest that asks for more is refused. The
capitalisation of Marita and DeFAULT is law in any string a player reads.
`level` IS A RUNG, NOT A MINIMUM. A job is offered while your level is
exactly its level and at no other time -- see game/questmodel.ts. So the
five obligations below all sit on rung 1 and the review sits on rung 2, and
the arithmetic between them is part of the content: the five pay 700 xp
between them and a level is 1000, so nothing here can level you off its own
rung before you have finished it. Whoever edits these numbers owns that sum.
THE TUTORIAL IS ON RUNG 1 TOO AND IS NOT ONE OF THE FIVE OBLIGATIONS.
`act0-ladmaster` is the first thing in the game: no requires, no needFlags,
nothing gates it. It pays 2 xp, which is deliberately nothing -- it is a
handshake, not a job -- so the rung-1 sum below is 702 against the 1000
that would level you off the rung. Whoever edits these numbers owns that
sum; server/quests-check.ts asserts it and names the five obligations by
id so a sixth job on rung 1 cannot quietly join them.
It carries `"bike": true`, which is the only quest in content/ that does:
accepting it puts a lime bike on clear ground within five metres of you.
See client/src/game/bikes.ts (placeLoanBike) -- the id is outside the
planned range, so it is a loan rather than one of the city's own.
The last 300 xp are knockouts, which is the point: Denise cannot sign you
off for a participation review until you have participated in something.
The review is the rung-2 door and its final conversation is where a handler
walks in.
Coordinates are world metres: +X east, +Z south, origin at Town Hall. The
Centrelink is the real Redfern office out of game/centrelink-data.ts.

quests.title: Down to the Fern
quests.blurb: Some bloke in the park reckons Cenno owes you money and has a bike you can borrow. He may be right about one of those.

steps.label: ride down to Redfern and find Ray

quests.title: Initial Participation Appointment
quests.blurb: You have been asked to attend the Redfern service centre. Attendance is compulsory. The appointment time was in a letter.

steps.label: get to the Redfern service centre

quests.title: Twenty Points of Job Search
quests.blurb: Twenty points a fortnight. Networking counts. Nobody has ever been able to tell you what a point is.

steps.label: get to Surry Hills, where the jobs are

quests.title: Evidence of Attendance
quests.blurb: The system did not record your attendance. Bring a photograph. Of the town hall. That will be fine.

steps.label: photograph the town hall as proof you exist

quests.title: Approved Travel
quests.blurb: You are eligible for assistance with transport to an appointment you have already attended. Take a train. Any train.

steps.label: catch a train to a station, any station

quests.title: Mandatory Upskilling
quests.blurb: A short course. Six hours. It is about resilience. Your provider is paid either way.

steps.label: have the course marked off at the desk

quests.title: Participation Review
quests.blurb: Denise would like to see you. It is not a breach. It is a review. There is a difference and she will explain it.
